<form string="Importe pagado (TRA)">
<header><button name="2040" type="action" string="Confirmar con evidencia" class="btn-primary" invisible="x_state in ('confirmado', 'anulado')"/><button name="2041" type="action" string="Anular" invisible="x_state == 'anulado'"/><field name="x_state" widget="statusbar" readonly="1"/></header>
<sheet><group>
<group string="Importe"><field name="x_sale_order_id" options="{'no_create': True}"/><field name="x_amount"/><field name="x_currency_id" options="{'no_create': True}"/><field name="x_cutoff_date"/></group>
<group string="Evidencia"><field name="x_evidence_kind"/><field name="x_evidence_ref"/><field name="x_evidence" filename="x_evidence_name"/><field name="x_evidence_name" invisible="1"/></group>
<group string="Confirmación"><field name="x_confirmed_by" readonly="1"/><field name="x_confirmed_at" readonly="1"/><field name="x_name"/><field name="x_note"/></group>
</group></sheet>
</form>

<list string="Importes pagados (TRA)"><field name="x_sale_order_id"/><field name="x_amount"/><field name="x_currency_id"/><field name="x_cutoff_date"/><field name="x_evidence_kind"/><field name="x_evidence_ref"/><field name="x_state"/><field name="x_confirmed_by"/><field name="x_confirmed_at"/></list>
